entities.summary: Nikolai Yuryevich Sobolev is a Russian video blogger, writer, businessman and singer. He is the creator and host of the YouTube channel SOBOLEV, where he talks about drama with the Russian side of YouTube. Sobolev is one of the co-founders of two YouTube collectives - "Rakamakafo" and "Ready Steady Go".
